title: CEGA-Tiny: simulation code and results for confidence-gated, energy-governed on-device learning under concept drift
description: Python notebooks, per-seed results, aggregate tables, figures and configuration behind the manuscript "CEGA-Tiny: A Confidence-Gated, Energy-Governed Controller for On-Device Learning under Concept Drift (A Trace-Driven Simulation Study)" (submitted to the Journal of Systems Architecture). All energy figures are operation-count model estimates; no hardware measurement was performed.
